title: cloud/sandbox is duplicated in ticks and ticfac with no drift guard between the copies
body: ticks kept cloud/sandbox for its internal/sandbox suite while the same tree moved here as the factory's embedded image context (identical today, verified by diff -rq). Nothing fails if the two copies drift, and the cold-start budget check here bounds a container built from the ticfac copy while ticks' internal/sandbox tests guard its own. A tick should decide the authority (one repo vendors the other, or a digest check pins the pair).
